children: Tesla (TSLA) plans capex over $25B in 2026 for AI chips, data centers and factory capacity, about 57%+ of its cash and short-term investments as of June 30.
Fitch gave Tesla (TSLA) a BBB rating, citing 2026 capex likely above $25B, potential multi-year negative free cash flow, mid-teens EBITDA margins, and up to $30B in possible debt facilities.
Tesla (TSLA) adds Grok AI to cars with AMD chips on software 2025.26+ via Wi‑Fi or Premium Connectivity. Demo showed inbox, calendar and document editing. Availability may change.
Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) reported August European registrations of 15,430 units, a 4% year-over-year increase; registrations in the European Union rose nearly 53% year-over-year for the month.
Tesla (TSLA) holds Bitcoin on its balance sheet. Traders note BTC volatility and short-squeeze-driven moves could impact Tesla’s mark-to-market exposure; ETF demand may affect future swings.
Belgian NGO tested Tesla FSD over ~400 km near Brussels in July; system often exceeded posted limits in 20–30 km/h zones and sometimes showed higher limits than road signs.
TSLA one-month implied volatility near 36th percentile ahead of Roadster reveal, indicating short-dated options priced low versus historical range for that one-month horizon prior to the event.
TSLA pre-market up 0.45% at $380.62 after coverage showing Grok available and demos; price reflects pre-market trading.
